decisions.reason: The same source message already has a complete MODIFY under this Requirement establishing all 77 Google Play languages; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Selecting all approximately 40 App Store languages does not necessarily change the existing iOS size-optimization goal or remote-asset strategy.
The selected language coverage does not change the existing tutorial delivery mechanism or reusable translatable-text presentation format.
The language-set decision does not necessarily modify the Android package-size optimization requirement or establish a new optimization method.
